auth.label: Channel Access Token
auth.description: LINE Messaging API channel access token sent as a Bearer credential. Manage it at https://developers.line.biz/console/.

actions.name: get_bot_info
actions.description: Get profile and chat settings for the connected LINE Official Account.

inputSchema.description: The empty input for reading LINE bot information.

userId.description: The LINE user ID of the bot.

basicId.description: The basic ID of the LINE Official Account.

premiumId.description: The premium ID when one is configured.

displayName.description: The display name of the LINE Official Account.

pictureUrl.description: The HTTPS profile image URL when one is configured.

chatMode.description: The configured LINE Official Account chat mode.

markAsReadMode.description: The automatic read setting for received messages.

outputSchema.description: The connected LINE Official Account information.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Get the LINE profile of a user who can interact with the connected bot.

userId.description: The LINE user ID obtained from a Messaging API webhook.

language.description: The user's BCP 47 language tag when consent permits it.

pictureUrl.description: The user's HTTPS profile image URL when one is configured.

statusMessage.description: The user's status message when one is configured.

outputSchema.description: The LINE user's available profile information.

actions.name: send_broadcast_text
actions.description: Send up to five text messages to all friends of the LINE Official Account.

items.description: A non-empty text message preserved exactly as provided.

texts.description: The text messages to send in order.

notificationDisabled.description: Whether LINE should suppress push notifications for the sent messages.

retryKey.description: An optional caller-generated UUID used by LINE to deduplicate a retried request.

actions.name: send_multicast_text
actions.description: Send up to five text messages to as many as 500 LINE users.

items.description: A LINE user ID obtained from the Messaging API.
A non-empty text message preserved exactly as provided.

texts.description: The text messages to send in order.

notificationDisabled.description: Whether LINE should suppress push notifications for the sent messages.

retryKey.description: An optional caller-generated UUID used by LINE to deduplicate a retried request.

actions.name: send_push_text
actions.description: Send up to five text messages to one LINE user, group, or multi-person chat.

to.description: The target LINE user, group, or room ID.

items.description: A non-empty text message preserved exactly as provided.

texts.description: The text messages to send in order.

notificationDisabled.description: Whether LINE should suppress push notifications for the sent messages.

retryKey.description: An optional caller-generated UUID used by LINE to deduplicate a retried request.

id.description: The message identifier assigned by LINE.

quoteToken.description: The token that can be used to quote this message.
